name: pacify-x-vscode
description: Governed operational dashboard and native VS Code control surface for Pacify-X.

chatParticipants.name: px
chatParticipants.description: Query governed Pacify-X workspace context without transferring host authority.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show current PX runtime, memory, coordination, and source identity

commands.name: context
commands.description: Show the exact bounded context PX can provide to this chat

commands.name: skills
commands.description: Show the separated PX, preserved, vendor, and enterprise skill domains

commands.title: Set Up Agent Studio and Workflow Studio

pacifyX.engineRoot.description: Pacify-X root containing runtime/cli.py and registry/. Empty enables workspace auto-discovery.

pacifyX.pythonPath.description: Python executable used only for explicit Pacify-X validation commands.

pacifyX.workspaceRoot.description: Optional Pacify-X workspace-manager root used for canonical memory telemetry. Cross-IDE coordination remains project-owned under the open workspace.

pacifyX.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Visible-dashboard fallback refresh interval. Hidden views suspend polling; revisions and explicit actions remain primary.

pacifyX.showAdvancedSurfaces.description: Reveal Knowledge Core and Runtime Core in the dashboard navigation.

pacifyX.contextInjectionCapTokens.description: Maximum declared token budget for portable context snapshots.

pacifyX.activity.enabled.description: Record local metadata-only AI, agent, editor, task, debug, test, terminal, MCP, and workspace activity in the project-owned Pacify-X trace ledger.

pacifyX.activity.paused.description: Pause activity recording without deleting retained evidence.

pacifyX.activity.captureFileEvents.description: Record bounded file/editor lifecycle metadata, relative scope references, and change counts. File contents are never retained.

pacifyX.activity.captureTerminalLifecycl.description: Record terminal and shell-execution lifecycle metadata. Command text remains off unless separately enabled.

pacifyX.activity.captureTaskLifecycle.description: Record VS Code task lifecycle and exit status metadata.

pacifyX.activity.captureDebugLifecycle.description: Record debug-session lifecycle metadata without debug payloads or variable contents.

pacifyX.activity.captureTestLifecycle.description: Record available VS Code test-result lifecycle metadata without test output content.

pacifyX.activity.captureMcpCalls.description: Record start/end/error metadata and hashes for calls handled by the bundled Pacify-X MCP server.

pacifyX.activity.captureCommandText.description: Allow the first executable token to be recorded for trusted terminal shell executions. Full commands remain hash-only and terminal output is never retained.

pacifyX.activity.retentionDays.description: Declared local trace-retention intent. Automatic destructive purge remains disabled and requires a separately governed cleanup action.

pacifyX.billable.enabled.description: Master permission for separately configured billable providers. Enabling this does not create credentials, connect to a provider, or authorize an execution by itself.

pacifyX.guardrails.maxCostPerTaskUsd.description: Hard USD cost ceiling per task. Zero denies billable task execution.

pacifyX.guardrails.maxCostPerSessionUsd.description: Hard USD cost ceiling per IDE/agent session. Zero denies billable session execution.

pacifyX.guardrails.maxCostPerDayUsd.description: Hard USD cost ceiling per day. Zero denies billable daily execution.

pacifyX.guardrails.tokenBudget.description: Maximum tokens allowed for one governed provider execution.

pacifyX.guardrails.localFirst.description: Require an admitted local route to be preferred before provider escalation.

pacifyX.guardrails.providerAllowlist.description: Provider identifiers admitted for billable evaluation. Empty denies every billable provider.

pacifyX.guardrails.gpuMemoryCeilingMb.description: GPU memory ceiling in MiB. Zero denies GPU allocation on billable routes.

pacifyX.guardrails.cpuCoreCeiling.description: Maximum logical CPU cores assignable to one governed execution.

pacifyX.guardrails.ramCeilingMb.description: Maximum system RAM in MiB assignable to one governed execution.

pacifyX.guardrails.escalationConfidenceT.description: Minimum confidence required before an external provider escalation can be considered.

pacifyX.guardrails.cacheReuseAggressiven.description: How aggressively governed executions should reuse compatible cached results.

pacifyX.guardrails.requireApprovalBefore.description: Require a fresh explicit human approval before every billable execution.

pacifyX.codexSandbox.description: Requested effect recorded in the governed handoff to the current Codex host. Pacify-X never starts Codex or grants the effect; workspace-write also requires an active repository claim.

pacifyX.ollama.enabled.description: Register locally discovered Ollama models with the VS Code Language Model API.

pacifyX.ollama.baseUrl.description: Local Ollama API base URL. Only loopback HTTP endpoints are admitted.
